snippet.title: My Card Is Better Than Your Card! - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
🌟Become the coolest kid on the playground in this playful deckbuilder roguelike.💫
🐝🐸Craft every card yourself with adorable stickers and wow your rivals in tug-of-war card battles full of wonder! 🦎🦦
⭐ Wishlist on Steam NOW! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3617620?utm_source=ytub 🪄
